## Checklist

- [ ] No clippy warnings (`cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`)
- [ ] Code is formatted (`cargo fmt --all -- --check`)
- [ ] New features include tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated if needed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated
